verbose.description: Enable verbose logging (INFO level and above)

debug.description: Enable debug logging (very verbose; not recommended for production)

transport_url.description: Message queue transport URL for RPC (e.g., RabbitMQ or Qpid)

api_endpoint.description: URL of the Ironic API endpoint (including port and scheme)

auth_url.description: Keystone auth URL for Ironic API authentication

project_name.description: Project (tenant) name used by the agent to authenticate with Ironic

username.description: Username (service account) for Ironic API authentication

auth_type.description: Authentication type for Ironic API access (typically 'password')

service_token_roles.description: List of roles required in service tokens to access Ironic API

service_token_required.description: Whether service tokens are required for Ironic API access

neutron_auth_url.description: Keystone auth URL for Neutron (if different from [DEFAULT])

neutron_user_domain_name.description: Keystone user domain for Neutron auth

neutron_project_domain_name.description: Keystone project domain for Neutron auth

neutron_request_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for Neutron API requests

service_credentials_auth_type.description: Fallback auth type (for older deployments using [service_credentials] section)

agent_workers.description: Number of worker processes for the agent

agent_polling_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between polling Ironic for node status updates

agent_enable_dhcp.description: Enable DHCP management for bare metal instances via Neutron DHCP agent

agent_enable_l3.description: Enable L3 (routing) management for bare metal instances via Neutron L3 agent

physical_network_mappings.description: List of mappings from logical network names to physical network names/interfaces (format: 'net:iface')
